servicesTitle: Three details. One clear price each.
servicesIntro: Pick what your car needs, from a deep interior clean to lasting paint protection.

services.name: Basic Wash
services.text: A careful hand wash with wheels, tires, windows and a hand dry.

services.name: Showroom Exterior
services.text: Iron remover, clay and paint sealant for decontaminated paint with a true showroom gloss.

services.name: Gold Interior
services.text: Steam, carpet, upholstery and leather cleaning, with interior protection.

services.name: Platinum Detail
services.text: Deep Interior plus Showroom Exterior. Their flagship, about 6 hours.

services.name: 1-Year Ceramic
services.text: Wash, decontamination, 1-step machine polish and a one-year ceramic coating.

services.name: 5-Year Ceramic
services.text: Paint correction and a five-year ceramic coating, with glass and wheel face protection.
